What it does

ChatGPT is the most flexible tool here and the one most likely to be genuinely useful on a daily basis — drafting quotes and emails, explaining a regulation in plain language, summarising a specification or writing job adverts. Its failure mode is confident invention, so anything technical, legal or regulatory needs checking before it reaches a customer.

Where the AI actually is

Large language model for drafting text, explaining problems and analysing documents.

Pros

  • Drafts quotes, emails, job descriptions and ad copy
  • Explains codes, materials and methods in plain language
  • Free tier is capable

Cons

  • Will state things confidently that are wrong — verify anything technical or regulatory

Who it suits

Built with Plumbers, Electricians, HVAC, Roofers, Landscapers, Remodelers & carpenters, General contractors in mind. Everyone — it is the most flexible tool on this list.
